title: Family
ownerHint: You are the admin. Add each family member with their name, their email and a first password. They sign in with the email; everyone sees the name.
memberHint: Everyone who can use the app. Only the admin can add or remove people.
name: Name
tempPasswordHint: At least 6 letters or digits. They choose their own password the first time they sign in.
removeHint: They can no longer sign in. Everything they already entered stays.
adminHint: They will manage the family instead of you. You stay as a member.
loadFailed: Couldn't load the family. Check your connection.

errors.bad_name: Write the name in English letters
errors.owner_only: Only the admin can do this
errors.failed: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.
errors.weak_password: That password is too easy to guess. Try another one.
errors.add_failed: Couldn't add them. Check your connection and try again.
errors.email_taken: This email already has a login. Use another email.
errors.suspended: This family is paused. Contact the person who runs the app.

nameHint: In English letters. This is the name everyone sees in the app.
emailHint: They sign in with this email. No email? Use yours with a tag, like you+mama@gmail.com.
inviteText: Join {family} on our family accounts app. Open this link on your iPhone to sign in:
inviteWithLogin: Join {family} on our family accounts app. Open this link on your iPhone and sign in with your email {email} and the password {password}. You will choose your own password after that.
inviteOwnerHint: Send someone the app link by message or WhatsApp. Add them above first so they can sign in.
inviteMemberHint: Send someone the app link by message or WhatsApp. The admin still needs to add them before they can sign in.
inviteCopied: Invite copied. Paste it in a message.
inviteFailed: Couldn't send the invite. Try again.
